name: Pivoxazepam
summary: Pivoxazepam is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative. It is the pivalate (2,2-dimethylpropanoate) ester of oxazepam. It has sedative and anxiolytic actions like those of other benzodiazepines. Compared to its parent drug, oxazepam, pivoxazepam is more rapidly absorbed and slightly more sedative.

pharmacology.text: It has sedative and anxiolytic actions like those of other benzodiazepines.

uses.en: It was studied as a sedative and anti-anxiety drug. It is not widely used in medicine.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究作為鎮靜和抗焦慮藥物，但在醫療上並不常用。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究作为镇静和抗焦虑药物，但在医疗上并不常用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Benzodiazepines as a group cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and slowed reactions. Regular use leads to dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平類整體而言會引起嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題和反應變慢。規律使用會導致依賴，長期大量使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷症狀，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平类整体而言会引起嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题和反应变慢。规律使用会导致依赖，长期大量使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断症状，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: Pivoxazepam is oxazepam with a pivalate ester attached, and oxazepam is itself one of the substances the body makes when it breaks down diazepam.
fact.zh: Pivoxazepam 是在奧沙西泮上接了特戊酸酯，而奧沙西泮本身就是人體分解二氮平時產生的物質之一。
fact.zhHans: Pivoxazepam 是在奥沙西泮上接了特戊酸酯，而奥沙西泮本身就是人体分解二氮平时产生的物质之一。
